svg.title: Fix, for each signed translation, one permutation implementing that symmetry on the layout. The activity pairs obeying all these fixed permutations form a linear subspace HP . Its seminorm is (LCN1). Use its separated completion bHP ; the map from the original presentation is an isometry after identifying seminorm-zero differences. This retains the off-mask regular germs required by the derivative budget, rather than identifying them merely by their evaluated values outside the healthy domain. The scalar-plus-activity space has norm ∥(λ, A)∥= max(|λ|, ∥A∥P ). The actual retained activities have norm at most 1/8 in these coordinates.
